_doc: Identity map for web marketing captures.
The live pages read production Supabase. Production rows carry the display
names of real dev and personal accounts (including the owner's own). Those
names must never appear in marketing material, so every recorded response is
rewritten through this map before it is committed as a fixture.
The cast is NOT invented here. It is the same 19-person world the iOS
repo), so a viewer who sees the app screenshots and the web screenshots sees
one coherent scene instead of two unrelated sets of strangers.
Event names follow qa/marketing-account/NAMING.md: Inland Empire geography,
no QA/Demo/Test strings, no 'PickleCue' in a fictional event name. The
production rows still carry superseded LA-world names; they are renamed here
rather than in the database, because the database is production.
_places_doc: Venue and place names that appear OUTSIDE the event title — most often in
an event description. These are a separate map because rewriting the event
name alone leaves the venue behind: 'Sunset Courts Open' became 'Cucamonga
Peak Classic' while its description still read 'at Sunset Courts'.
Replacement is longest-match-first, so the event name wins over the venue
_banned_doc: Fragments that must never survive into a fixture. Unlike the maps above
these are not rewritten — their presence FAILS the run, because a fragment
we did not anticipate means the scrub is incomplete rather than wrong.
The geography list is the superseded LA marketing world plus the non-SoCal
